injection_contract.construct: construct pinned Waku normally in an isolated dedicated home
injection_contract.registry: obtain its runtime ToolRegistry and the existing save_note Tool
injection_contract.replacement: register a same-name Tool preserving the original name, description, input_schema and wants_notify semantics, replacing only fn with a deterministic function that raises error_text
injection_contract.scope: do not alter any other registered Tool and do not edit pinned Waku source or tests
injection_contract.normal_error_path: ToolRegistry.execute() must surface the exception through Waku's normal model-visible error path
validation: exactly one save_note registration is active
before/after registry snapshots show only save_note changed
all non-save_note tool names and schemas remain unchanged
do not call the faulting fn before target execution

failure_scope: Only save_note fails; no other local tool is altered by this injection.
retry_rule: No retry beyond the declared loop bound without a fresh tool result; never write around the failed tool.
evidence: final reply distinction between attempted, failed, and completed
